en: I sank in the mud yesterday.
I didn't drown in the swimming pool yesterday.
You sank in the river yesterday.
You didn't drown because you knew how to swim.
You (f.) sank in the sea in the summer.

ar: ما غرقتيش حيت الما كان قليل
en: You (f.) didn't drown because there was little water.
The boat sank in the sea.
The ship didn't sink during the night.
The boat sank in the river.
The girl didn't drown in the swimming pool.
We drowned in debts this year.
We didn't drown in this water.

lat: wash ghreqtu f l-wa7l b juj
en: Did you sink in the mud together?
You didn't drown because you wore the life jacket.

lat: l-kisan gherqu f s-stel dyal l-ma
en: The glasses sank in the bucket of water.
The children didn't drown in the sea.

ar: انا كنغرق الى ما عرفتش نعوم
en: I drown if I can't swim.
I don't drown because I know how to swim.

lat: nta katghreq f kas dyal l-ma
en: You drown in a glass of water.

ar: ما كتغرقش الى بقيتي حدا الشط
en: You don't drown if you stay near the shore.
You (f.) drown in the swimming pool all the time.
You (f.) don't drown because you swim well.
Stone always sinks in water.
Wood doesn't sink in the sea.
The piece of iron sinks in water.
The boat doesn't sink in the waves.
We drown in work every day.
We don't drown if we swim slowly.
You drown in problems a lot.
You don't drown because you have life jackets.
The boats sink in the big sea.

lat: huma ma kaygherqush f had l-blasa
en: They don't drown in this place.
If I go in, I am going to drown now.

lat: ma ghadish nghreq f l-b7er l-yum
en: I am not going to drown in the sea today.

lat: nta ghadi tghreq f had l-wad
en: You are going to drown in this river.

lat: ma ghadish tghreq ila shedditi fiyya
ar: ما غاديش تغرق الى شديتي فيا
en: You are not going to drown if you hold onto me.

lat: nti ghadi tgherqi ila mshiti tmmak
ar: نتي غادي تغرقي الى مشيتي تماك
en: You (f.) are going to drown if you go over there.

ar: ما غاديش تغرقي حيت معاك ختك
en: You (f.) are not going to drown because your sister is with you.
This boat is going to sink tomorrow.

lat: l-batu ma ghadish yghreq f s-sfer
en: The ship is not going to sink on the voyage.

lat: hiya ghadi tghreq ila bqat tema
ar: هي غادي تغرق الى بقات تما
en: She is going to drown if she stays there.

lat: hiya ma ghadish tghreq f had s-sif
ar: هي ما غاديش تغرق فهاد الصيف
en: She is not going to drown this summer.

ar: حنا غادي نغرقو الى ما خرجناش
en: We are going to drown if we don't get out.
We are not going to drown in the swimming pool.

lat: ntuma ghadi tgherqu ila dkhultu l l-b7er
ar: نتوما غادي تغرقو الى دخلتو للبحر
en: You are going to drown if you go into the sea.

lat: ntuma ma ghadish tgherqu m3a l-ustad dyalkum
ar: نتوما ما غاديش تغرقو مع الاستاذ ديالكم
en: You are not going to drown with your teacher.

lat: huma ghadi ygherqu f hadak l-bir
en: They are going to drown in that well.

lat: huma ma ghadish ygherqu f had l-wad
ar: هما ما غاديش يغرقو فهاد الواد
en: They are not going to drown in this river.
